sections.text:
-Increases the activation priority of this Unison effect by 1.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces Unison gauge by 20.
Unison gauge reduction boosted by 5 for each increase in Skill level.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces status ailment resistance value by 100 for 120 seconds.
-Target: all enemies. Applies Karma.
-Target: all enemies. Removes buffs.
-Target: all allies excluding yourself. Fills Unison gauge by 30.
-Target: all enemies. Reduces fixed damage taken to 0 (1 time only). [Demerit]
-Target: yourself. Applies Protection for 120 seconds (When in effect, damage to HP and CP will not be taken; increases DEF and MDEF by 100%; nullifies status ailments, debuffs, and buff removal effects. Removed after receiving a set amount of damage (300% of max HP excluding buff and field effects)).
-Applies Domination Collapse (nullifies the target's buffs, reduces the target's critical hit chance to zero, and increases Ability Power of damage taken by the target by 30) to the enemy Field for 60 seconds.
Increases stats selected in stat slot 1 by 20000
Increases stats selected in stat slot 2 by 20000

[Spelltaker] Lloyd or Ninoyu with the same or higher Cost of the base Monster can be used as fodder.
 *Specific Monsters may also be used. See the Help section for details.
